descriptions.data: SQL injection: User input concatenated into SQL query without parameterization.
descriptions.label: default

descriptions.data: User-controlled input is used directly in a SQL query without proper sanitization, allowing an attacker to manipulate the query.
descriptions.label: rationale

descriptions.data: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements instead of string concatenation to build SQL queries.
descriptions.label: check

descriptions.data: Use parameterized query: db.Query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?", userInput)
descriptions.label: fix

descriptions.data: Weak cryptographic algorithm MD5 used for password hashing.
descriptions.label: default

descriptions.label: rationale

descriptions.data: Replace MD5/SHA1 with SHA-256 or stronger algorithms for cryptographic purposes.
descriptions.label: check

descriptions.data: Replace md5.New() with sha256.New() or use bcrypt for password hashing.
descriptions.label: fix
